name: Vertex
description: One polygon per cell, turning further the further it sits from the middle.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 5; scale: 0.92); clip-path: @shape(points: 5; scale: 0.92); -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(72 * @sqrt(@abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) * @abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) + @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y) * @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y)))deg); transform: rotate(@calc(72 * @sqrt(@abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) * @abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) + @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y) * @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y)))deg); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
